agents.title: Agents on trial
agents.help: The Fabric data agents being evaluated. Pick one to see the questions the jury has proposed for it.

caseBoard.title: Cases
caseBoard.help: Questions for this agent with the answers the jury expects. Each column shows how far the jury has got in agreeing on an answer.

caseDetail.title: Case
caseDetail.help: One question and the expected answers proposed for it, each with the definition its author used.

caseValidity.unverifiedHelp: Written by someone who is not on the jury. It is shown but never used in a hearing.

case.meaning: A business question to test the agent with.

ruling.meaning: The jury agrees on the right answer. Ruled cases become case law.

hearing.meaning: A test run: the agent answers, the AI judge scores each answer.

appeal.meaning: A juror says the judge got it wrong. Appeals lower judge trust.

docket.readOnly: You can read the docket. Only active jurors can propose cases, add answers and vote; ask an admin if you should be on the jury.

cases.title: The full docket
cases.help: Every case moves left to right: the jury reviews it, settles any dispute, and rules. Ruled cases become case law, the test the agent has to pass.
cases.empty: No cases for {{agent}} yet. Propose the first question the agent should answer.
cases.noMatch: No cases match this search or filter.
cases.tip: Tip: a good case has one right answer that a business expert can check. "How are sales going?" is not a case; "Net sales in October 2026?" is.

caseDetail.notFound: This case doesn't exist, or it was proposed in another app.

reason.dismissed: This case was dismissed: it is kept in the record but never used in a hearing.
reason.noAnswers: No answer yet. Add the answer the agent should give.
reason.competingAnswers: Two answers have votes in favour. Vote for the one the agent should give, or propose a better one.
reason.approverSplit: Approvers disagree about the same answer. Read the reasons in the court record.
reason.ruled: The jury agreed on the answer. This case is now case law.
reason.needsApprover: Enough votes, but no approver has confirmed the answer yet.
reason.approverAgainst: An approver voted against the leading answer.

caseDetail.noAnswers: Nobody has answered this question yet.

vote.commentHint: Required. Other jurors read it in the court record.
vote.commentRequired: Say why, so the jury can settle it.
vote.ownAnswer: Your own answer: your vote on it wouldn't count.
vote.doneFor: Your vote for answer {{letter}} is in the record.
vote.doneAgainst: Your vote against answer {{letter}} is in the record.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this case
dismiss.help: Dismissed cases stay in the record but are never used in a hearing. Only the author or an admin can dismiss a case.
dismiss.reason: Why is it not a good test question?

diff.title: Where the definitions part ways
diff.help: Highlighted rows are the real disagreement. Settle these and the case settles itself.
diff.caption: Definitions of answer {{left}} and answer {{right}}, rule by rule
diff.addDetails: Add the definition to see where they differ.

record.title: Court record
record.notCounted: not counted: not an active juror
record.futureDated: dated in the future, not counted
record.footnote: The record is never edited. Every vote and answer stays here, so anyone can see how the jury got to its ruling.

answerForm.answerHint: The value the agent should give, e.g. 2,310 or Mountain-200 Black.
answerForm.definitionHint: One sentence: how you got this answer.
answerForm.definitionRequired: Explain how you got the answer.
answerForm.detailsHelp: Fill these in so the jury can see exactly where two answers differ.

proposeCase.title: Propose a case for {{agent}}
proposeCase.help: A good case has one right answer that a business expert can check.
proposeCase.question: Question
proposeCase.questionHint: Ask it the way a business user would ask the agent.
proposeCase.categoryHint: Pick an existing one or type a new one.
proposeCase.answerFailed: The case was saved, but its answer wasn't. Try again: only the answer will be added.
proposeCase.openCase: Open the case without an answer

expert.label: Expert
expert.description: proposes cases and answers, and votes on them

approver.label: Approver
approver.description: also confirms rulings: a case needs an approver's vote to be ruled

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: also manages jurors and agents in the clerk's office

home.kicker: Quality control for Fabric data agents
home.title: Who judges the judge?
home.lead: An AI judge scores every answer your data agents give. Your business experts are the jury: they agree on the right answers and catch the judge when it gets one wrong.
home.trustPending: Shown after the first hearings: how often the jury agrees with the AI judge.
home.docketHelp: Cases for the agent you pick. Cases waiting for your vote come first.
home.noAgents: No agents on trial yet. An admin registers them in the clerk's office.

clerk.title: Clerk's office
clerk.help: Decide who sits on the jury and which agents stand trial. Every change is checked on the server and written to the admin log.
clerk.protectedBody: The server checks that you are an active admin before saving anything. If it can't confirm it, nothing changes.
clerk.notAdmin: Only active admins can use the clerk's office. Ask an admin if you need access.
clerk.loading: The clerk is fetching the records…

jurors.title: The jury
jurors.caption: Jurors
jurors.footnote: Deactivating keeps everything a juror said in the court record; they just can't vote or propose any more. Nobody is ever deleted.
jurors.emptyActive: No active jurors yet. Swear in the first one with the form.
jurors.emptyInactive: Nobody is inactive. Deactivated jurors appear here.

swearIn.title: Swear in a juror
swearIn.emailHint: Must be the email they use to sign in to Fabric.
swearIn.emailInvalid: Enter a work email such as name@example.com.
swearIn.displayNameHint: Optional. If empty, the part of the email before the @ is shown.
swearIn.teamHint: Optional. Shown next to their name.

latest.title: Latest admin changes
latest.empty: No admin changes yet. They appear here as soon as someone makes one.

agents.title: Agents on trial
agents.help: The Fabric data agents the jury writes cases for. Retiring one keeps its cases and hearings.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Register the first one.
agents.emptyActive: No active agents. Reinstate one or register a new one.
agents.emptyRetired: No retired agents. Retired agents keep their cases and appear here.

registerAgent.title: Register an agent
registerAgent.name: Agent name
registerAgent.nameHint: How the jury will see it.
registerAgent.idHint: Copy it from the agent's address in Fabric.
registerAgent.invalidId: This must be an ID like 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-…

log.title: Admin log
log.help: Every admin request and its result, including rejected attempts. The record is never edited.
log.caption: Admin log
log.loadError: The admin log could not be loaded.
log.onlyChecks: Only automated checks so far. Tick "Show automated checks" to see them.

entry.unknown: {{who}} sent a request the office doesn't know

attempt.editJurorDetails: {{who}} tried to edit the details of {{target}}
attempt.readAdminLog: {{who}} tried to open the admin log
attempt.unknown: {{who}} sent a request the office doesn't know

errors.onlyAdmins: Only active admins can do this.
errors.selfProtection: You can't deactivate yourself or remove your own admin role.
errors.jurorExists: This email is already on the jury.
errors.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.notFound: That juror or agent no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.notSignedIn: You need to be signed in to do this.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.limitExceeded: A hearing takes only a few questions. Choose fewer.
errors.noCases: Only ruled cases can go to a hearing. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.hearingInProgress: Another hearing is in session. Wait for it to end, then try again.
errors.cooldown: The last hearing ended less than ten minutes ago. Give the capacity a rest and try again.
errors.fabricError: Fabric could not start or check the hearing. Nothing was lost; the hearing is recorded as failed.

hearings.title: Hearings
hearings.help: A hearing puts an agent on the stand. It answers the questions the jury has ruled on, and the AI judge says whether each answer matches the jury's.

list.title: Past and current hearings
list.none: No hearing yet for this agent. The jury's ruled questions are waiting for the first one.
list.noneViewer: No hearing yet for this agent. An admin can start one.

launch.title: Start a hearing
launch.help: Choose which ruled questions to put to the agent. Only questions the jury has ruled on can be asked; their ruled answer is what the judge compares against.
launch.noRuled: This agent has no ruled cases yet. A case is ruled when two jurors back one answer and one of them is an approver.
launch.estimate: About {{minutes}} minutes: roughly {{seconds}} seconds per question, plus about two minutes to get the courtroom ready.
launch.capacity: Hearings use the capacity that this app and its agents share. One hearing runs at a time, with ten minutes of rest between hearings.
launch.busy: A hearing is in session. Start the next one when it ends.
launch.adminOnly: Only admins can start a hearing.

session.title: Questioning the {{agent}}
session.estimate: About {{minutes}} minutes left. You can leave: the hearing keeps going and you will find it in Hearings.
session.overtime: Taking longer than expected. You can leave: the hearing keeps going.

refresh.auto: This page re-reads itself every minute while this tab is open and the hearing is in session.
refresh.paused: Automatic updates stopped. Press Refresh to check again.

ended.cancelled: The hearing was cancelled. The verdicts below were given before that.
ended.no_news: No news from this hearing for longer than expected. It may have stopped.

actions.checkHelp: One question to Fabric about the job, no more.

verdicts.title: Verdicts as they arrive
verdicts.empty: No verdicts yet. The first appears when the agent has answered question 1.
verdicts.reviewSoon: The jury will be able to confirm or appeal each verdict in the next step.

errors.load: The data could not be loaded.
errors.save: The change could not be saved. Nothing was lost; try again.
errors.notSignedIn: You need to be signed in to do this.
